---
title-en: "English title"
title-fr: "Titre français"
filters: [langsel]
---

Regression fixture for `_extensions/langsel`. Rendered twice by
`tools/test-langsel.sh` (once with `lang: en`, once with `lang: fr`).

Catches the two failure modes seen so far:

1. **Non-recursive filtering** — language divs nested inside other divs
   (e.g. `::: {.en}` inside `:::: {.dl-strip}`) leaking into the wrong render.
2. **Duplicate labels** — if both languages leak through, the two headings
   below share a Typst label and the PDF build dies.

:::: {.dl-strip}
::: {.en}
English nested pill.
:::

::: {.fr}
Pastille française imbriquée.
:::
::::

::: {.en}
## Shared heading {#dup}

English top-level paragraph.
:::

::: {.fr}
## Titre partagé {#dup-fr}

Paragraphe français de premier niveau.
:::
